name: Pennsylvania

response.rule_text: Agency must respond within five business days of the open-records officer receiving a written request; no response is a deemed denial (65 P.S. § 67.901). With one of seven listed reasons and notice within the five business days, the agency gets up to 30 days to respond (§ 67.902); RCFP does not label the unit.

fees.labor_rule: No fee for agency review to decide whether a record is public; other fees only where agency necessarily incurs costs and must be reasonable; staff payroll not chargeable (§ 67.1307(g)).
fees.copy_rule: Duplication fees reasonable and based on prevailing fees for comparable services (§ 67.1307(b)(2)); postage at actual cost.
fees.waiver_rule: Optional: agency may waive duplication fees if requester duplicates or public interest (§ 67.1307(f)).
fees.estimate_required: Prepayment of estimate allowed if fees expected to exceed $100 (§ 67.1307(h)).

residency.rule_text: Requester must be a legal resident of the United States (§ 67.102 'requester'); state residency not required.

appeal.body: Office of Open Records (appeals officer), then Commonwealth Court or county Court of Common Pleas
appeal.rule_text: Appeal to OOR within 15 business days of the agency response mailing or deemed denial; OOR final determination within 30 days (§ 67.1101-1310); petition for review within 30 days of final determination.

format_rule: Record provided in the medium requested if it exists in that medium (§ 67.701(a)); no duty to create new records (§ 67.705).
notes: Read chars 0-100k and 170-270k. Extension nulled: the 30-day unit is not labeled by RCFP and whether it runs from the notice or the request is not stated; see rule_text. RCFP chapter last updated Oct 2019. Legislature covered for 'legislative records' only. State-related universities (Temple, Pitt, Penn State, Lincoln) have reporting duties under §§ 67.1501-1504; PASSHE and community colleges are state-affiliated.
